name: Bamboo-shoot salad
summary: Bamboo shoot shaved and boiled, then mixed with belly pork, shrimp, rau răm, fried shallot, and peanuts. Sweet-sour fish sauce is tossed in, or left on the side.
origin: Củ Chi. Người Lao Động ties the shoot to tầm vông, tre, and trúc in the district. Báo Quốc tế calls it a household plate.
howToEat: Shave and boil the bamboo until ivory, then mix it with boiled belly pork and shrimp, rau răm, fried shallot, and peanuts. Eat it plain, or with fried shrimp crackers and sweet-sour fish sauce.
Another version uses fresh bamboo, belly pork, peeled shrimp, garlic, and chili, and leaves the sauce tossed in or on the side.
seoDescription: Bamboo-shoot salad with belly pork, shrimp, herbs, and sweet-sour fish sauce.
